instruction: Move "Sheet3" so it appears between "Sheet1" and "Sheet2", then rename it to "Index".

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully renamed Sheet1 to LARS Resources, copied it before Sheet2 as LARS Resources (Backup), and renamed Sheet2 to LARS Resources (Offline) in 21 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can rename sheets via right-click context menu, copy sheets with positioning, manage sheet tab operations in LibreOffice Calc
metadata.task_rationale: Tests sheet moving and renaming - the original task involved copying+positioning, this variation tests moving+renaming
metadata.explanation: Task requires moving Sheet3 between Sheet1 and Sheet2, then renaming it to Index. Evaluator checks final sheet order is ['Sheet1', 'Index', 'Sheet2'].

scoring_breakdown.sheet_names_present: partial - each correct name contributes equally
